attack.why: Sin's fins are no feet-standing figures: each NEAR painting is a warp of the idle on the idle's own canvas (sidecar registrationVsIdle dx 0, dy 0), registered by construction. The hem rule read this attack at x 505 against the idle's 89.5 and slid it 416 px left of where it was painted: idle to attack overlapped 0.12 where the paintings overlap 0.77 (round 25: a 346 px cast-to-idle snap and 36 double images). Every NEAR painting of a fin stands at its canvas middle, so no plane is slid (r43-motion2).
